notes: Not yet measured against After Effects. Param indices checked against AE 26 parameter list (_ae_params.json): AE Position is three 1D sliders X/Y/Z (offsets from the layer centre, default 0), not a 2D point (2 is a group header): the shader now takes posX/posY. Rotation X/Y/Z = 8/9/10, Render 13, Light Intensity 15, Light Height 17, Light Direction 18, Ambient 21, Diffuse 22 (defaults from AE). Position Z, Rotation Order (11), Light Color (16), Specular/Roughness/Metal (23-25) and Rotation X/Z (read but unused) not modelled.
